correctness.rationale: For r(t)=(a cos t,b sin t), the direction of a chord side is governed by psi'(m)=ab/(a^2 sin^2 m+b^2 cos^2 m). Each opposite interior-angle sum is the integral of this positive pi-periodic function over a measurable subset of a 2pi period having total length pi. The threshold set where sin^2 m>=cos^2 m is exactly a length-pi set on which the derivative is minimal, so the rearrangement comparison gives the sharp lower bound 4 arctan(b/a). Applying the published convex-quadrilateral angular Ptolemy inequality to the smaller opposite-angle sum then yields p<=(a^2+b^2)/(2ab). The four axis endpoints attain equality directly. The bundled random stress test is diagnostic only; the global proof is the exact turning-integral argument.
